posts.text:
OpenAI releases GPT-6.1 Sol at a fifth of Astra's price

OpenAI says GPT-6.1 Sol nearly matches GPT-6 Astra on coding and computer use for $2 per million input tokens, with cached input at $0.10.

https://theaipost.net/story/cdd66acae/

OpenAI scraps GPT-6.1 Astra release over alignment concerns

OpenAI cancelled the planned October launch of GPT-6.1 Astra after internal tests found more deception and weaker alignment, the company told the Wall Street Journal.

https://theaipost.net/story/c27ee846a/

OpenAI launches Dots, always-on agents with their own cloud computers

Each Dot runs on GPT-6 Astra with its own cloud computer and browser, connects to more than 4,000 apps, and is included in Pro and Business Premium.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-openai-dots/

OpenAI adds $500 Pro plan and Ultrafast tier at 300 tokens a second

OpenAI says Ultrafast speeds up GPT-6 Astra to 300 tokens per second in Codex, costs 6x the standard rate, and needs the new $500-a-month Pro 500.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-openai-ultrafast-pro-500/

ChatGPT Space puts shared pages and agents in one workspace

OpenAI says ChatGPT Space, rolling out today to Pro, Business and Enterprise, lets people and Dots edit interactive pages with charts, checklists and dashboards.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-chatgpt-space-plugins/

OpenAI's annualized revenue nears $70 billion, Axios reports

Axios, citing unnamed sources, says OpenAI's run rate has grown more than 70% since July, with business revenue up more than 100%.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-openai-arr-70b/

Trump launches America.gov, an AI front door to federal services

The site lets users ask questions in plain language instead of navigating agency websites, and an executive order tells agencies to plug their services into it.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-america-gov-launch/

Anthropic's IPO filing lists up to $84.5 billion in SpaceX compute deals

The Information reports most of the commitment can be cancelled on 90 days' notice, one of the more flexible items in Anthropic's $518 billion compute tally.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-anthropic-spacex-compute/

Wajo launches Fo, an AI agent that phones, emails and pays for errands

Wajo says Fo finished 71% of 104 real-world tasks unaided, against 42% for OpenClaw, and hands the rest to human assistants.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-wajo-fo-agent/

InstaCloud launches a serverless cloud that coding agents operate themselves

The Y Combinator-backed service lets Claude Code or Cursor deploy apps, branch whole environments including data, and pause for human approval on risky changes.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-instacloud-agent-cloud/

McDonald's uses AI to set menu prices at 14,000 US restaurants, Reuters says

A Big Mac costs $5.69 in one Fresno company store and $6.89 two miles away, and five franchisees told Reuters McDonald's pressures them to follow the AI's price recommendations.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-mcdonalds-ai-pricing/

Trump hosts Nvidia, Anthropic and Palantir chiefs at White House AI lunch
https://theaipost.net/story/find-white-house-ai-lunch/

Anthropic's seven co-founders would keep 50.1% of votes after IPO

A draft IPO filing reviewed by Reuters gives Anthropic's seven co-founders one Class F share carrying 50.1% of the vote, held through a new Founder LLC.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-anthropic-founder-llc/

Pope Leo says AI risk warnings are not 'fake news', criticises Nvidia's Huang
https://theaipost.net/story/find-pope-leo-ai-fake-news/

Meta gives its Muse agent a small-business version wired into Shopify and Stripe

Meta's Muse for Small Business links its AI agent to 15 work apps plus Instagram, Facebook and ad accounts, free for most features in the US and Canada.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-meta-muse-small-business/

Google sues EU over orders opening Android's Gemini features to rivals
https://theaipost.net/story/find-google-eu-dma-appeal/

OpenAI halves API value of $200 Pro plan, reopens sign-ups

The $200 Pro plan reopens to new subscribers with usage worth half the API spend of the old plan, and no 5-hour limit, a post says.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-openai-pro-200-usage/

Modal Labs nears $750 million round at $15.75 billion valuation

TechCrunch reported the inference infrastructure startup's valuation has more than tripled in four months, as rival providers Baseten, Fireworks and Fal raise at similarly steep multiples.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-modal-labs-funding/

Developer splits a language model across seven microcontrollers
https://theaipost.net/story/find-esp32-bitnet-cluster/

Perplexity adds Profiles and Skills to its Agent API

Perplexity's Agent API can now save a model, tools, connectors and settings as one versioned Profile that every developer on a project can call, chief executive Aravind Srinivas said.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-perplexity-agent-profiles/

Gemini app adds Google Wallet as a connected app

Google added Google Wallet as a Connected App in Gemini, letting US users ask about boarding passes, loyalty cards and linked-account spending, 9to5Google reported.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-gemini-google-wallet/

Anthropic ships Claude Mods for customizing Claude Code

Claude Mods let developers customize Claude Code's execution loop and interface using hooks and plugins, Anthropic's Thariq Shihipar said in an interview with Latent Space.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-claude-mods-launch/

OpenAI apologizes to Australia over website breaches

OpenAI apologized for its models breaching Australian government websites and said it will form a taskforce to strengthen the country's cyber defenses, Bloomberg reported.

https://theaipost.net/story/c42ada9db/

Anthropic's IPO filing shows $42 billion net loss

Anthropic's prospectus reports a $41.97 billion net loss for fiscal 2025, even as revenue grew more than tenfold to $4.59 billion, Reuters reported after reviewing the filing.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-anthropic-ipo-financials/

xAI's Grok 4.7 lands on Amazon Bedrock

xAI's Grok 4.7 is now available on Amazon Bedrock with a 500,000-token context window and four configurable reasoning levels, Amazon Web Services said.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-grok-4-7-bedrock/

pwn.ai team cracks Google's KVM hypervisor challenge

A pwn.ai team used coordinated AI models to exploit a Linux KVM bug and capture the flag in Google's kvmCTF challenge, though a bounty was ruled out.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-pwnai-kvm-exploit/
